recent_articles.title: Hooch deaths: ‘Perfect case of government negligence; what was learned from 2015 Malwani liquor tragedy?’ asks Congress | Pune News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Following the deaths of over 20 people in Pune due to spurious liquor, **the Maharashtra government** has penalized 26 officials and employees. However, the **Congress party**, led by Sachin Sawant, criticized this action as insufficient and demanded accountability for past recommendations made after a similar tragedy in Malwani in 2015. The committee's recommendations included stricter control over methanol production and transportation, increased police and excise department campaigns against illegal liquor manufacturing, information sharing between departments, and strict enforcement of regulations. Sawant questioned the government's commitment to implementing these recommendations and demanded transparency regarding their status. He also highlighted the lack of preparedness in hospitals and the ease with which accused individuals were granted bail, emphasizing the need for stricter action against organized crime involved in illegal liquor trade.

recent_articles.title: After NEET leak storm, Latur’s coaching capital faces closure | Mumbai News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **District Industries Centre (DIC)** ordered the Latur Industrial Estate Co-operative Society to cease all non-manufacturing activities on plots originally allotted for industrial purposes. The order, issued following a meeting with **Latur Collector Dr Bharat Bastewad**, warned of legal action if compliance is not met.  **Dr Bastewad** stated that the administration wants to examine the legality of coaching classes operating from industrial plots and ensure all applicable rules are followed. This move has sparked concern among coaching operators, local businesses, and students who rely on the area's ecosystem.

recent_articles.title: Maharashtra Government Acquires Iconic Air India Building For Rs 1,601 Crore
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Maharashtra** government acquired the iconic Air India building in Nariman Point for Rs 1,601 crore. The transfer of ownership was completed at Mantralaya with Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis present after a cabinet meeting.  The state government had been negotiating to acquire the property since at least 2021 and the deal was finalized in March 2024. **Public Works Minister Shivendrasinh Bhosale** directed officials to conduct structural audits, undertake necessary repairs, and ensure high standards for electrical systems and other infrastructure before relocating government offices.

recent_articles.title: Telangana CM Revanth Reddy accuses his Maharashtra counterpart of showing callous apathy towards Tummidihatti barrage - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy** accused **Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis** of being apathetic to his requests for talks regarding the construction of the proposed Tummidihatti barrage in Telangana's Adilabad district.  **Revanth Reddy** demanded that **Union Minister G. Kishan Reddy** take the initiative to facilitate these talks, warning that farmers would erupt in anger if the project is not completed. He also asserted that the state government was committed to purchasing all procured paddy and maize by June 15th or face consequences, including dumping the grains in front of BJP leaders' houses.

recent_articles.title: A Maharashtra BJP pick for MLC polls with connection to Pawars: Who is Arun Lakhani? | Political Pulse News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Arun Lakhani**, a prominent Maharashtra BJP leader and close associate of Union Minister **Nitin Gadkari** and Chief Minister **Devendra Fadnavis**, has been nominated to represent the Wardha-Chandrapur-Gadchiroli Local Authorities constituency in the upcoming June 18 state MLC elections.  Lakhani's nomination has sparked debate due to his lack of local roots within the constituency, but he is a familiar face within the party and known for his work in infrastructure development and social initiatives. His son, Sarang Lakhani, is engaged to NCP (SP) MP **Supriya Sule’s** daughter, Revati, further adding to the political intrigue surrounding his candidacy.

recent_articles.title: Suman Kalyanpur death: Veteran playback singer dies at 89 in Mumbai - India Today
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Suman Kalyanpur**, a celebrated Indian playback singer, died on Sunday evening at the age of 89 in Mumbai.  The veteran singer, known for her melodious voice and classical finesse, left behind a rich musical legacy spanning over six decades. **Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis**, along with other prominent figures like **Sharad Pawar** and **Eknath Shinde**, mourned the loss of the "divine voice" who enriched India's musical heritage.  Her timeless songs in Marathi, Hindi, and several regional languages will continue to resonate with audiences for years to come.

recent_articles.title: Death toll in Pune hooch tragedy climbs to 15, cops arrest eight; CM promises to 'dismantle entire spurious liquor ecosystem'
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Maharashtra** Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis has ordered a crackdown on the illicit liquor trade following at least 14-15 deaths in Pune due to methanol-laced spurious liquor. The **Pune police** and **Excise authorities** suspect the liquor was laced with toxic substances, though the exact cause of death will be confirmed after post-mortem reports are received.  At least three people remain in critical condition. Eight individuals have been arrested, including the bootlegger and illicit liquor joint owner, Yogesh Wankhede.

recent_articles.title: 7 dead as car gets crushed between two container trucks in Pune
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Seven people were killed and over a dozen injured in a horrific accident on the Mumbai-Bengaluru Highway in Pune city. A car became trapped between two container trucks that caught fire after one lost control due to a suspected brake failure, according to **Deputy Commissioner of Police Sambhaji Kadam**.  **Pune police commissioner Amitesh Kumar**, who visited the scene, said the fire erupted due to the impact of the collision. **Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis** announced ₹5 lakh ex-gratia for the families of the deceased.

recent_articles.title: First-Ever Standalone Policy For Single Women To Be Introduced In This State | OdishaBytes
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Mahayuti** government in Maharashtra has approved the formation of a draft committee to develop a "Single Women Policy." The policy, spearheaded by **Women and Child Development minister Aditi Tatkare**, aims to empower single women across the state through access to government welfare schemes and addressing their unique concerns.  The policy will benefit widows, divorced, deserted, and unmarried women who often face social and economic challenges due to a lack of support systems. The committee will be chaired by the Commissioner of the Women and Child Development Commissionerate, Pune, and include representatives from various state departments.

recent_articles.title: Spurious liquor kills 15 in Pune, Pimpri-Chinchwad; 8 held, probe ordered - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: At least 15 people have died in Pune and Pimpri-Chinchwad after consuming spurious liquor, prompting an investigation by **Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis** and the **Excise Department**.  **Yogesh Wankhede**, who brought ethanol without permission, is suspected of preparing the illicit alcohol at a location in Hadapsar before supplying it to vendors. The deaths occurred over three days, with residents expressing anger towards authorities for allegedly failing to prevent the sale of illegal liquor.  The investigation is ongoing and more arrests are expected.

recent_articles.title: Fuel shortage hits pumps amid panic buying; OMCs call for calm, say supply is steady - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Farmers** across several states in India are facing fuel shortages due to the recent hike in fuel prices.  The **Centre** has implemented price hikes to mitigate losses for its oil marketing companies (OMCs), but this has led to supply disruptions and long queues at petrol stations.  In Maharashtra, **farmers** are struggling to procure diesel for their tractors, while in Punjab, the **Punjab Petrol Pump Dealers Association** reports short supplies of both petrol and diesel. The situation is impacting agricultural activities and transportation, with some fuel stations even running dry.  The **Petroleum Ministry** has assured the public that there is no shortage of fuel but urged people to avoid panic buying.

recent_articles.title: Manoj Jarange warns of fresh agitation over Maratha quota issue from May 30 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Manoj Jarange**, a Maratha quota activist, announced an indefinite hunger strike beginning May 30th over the **Maharashtra** government's failure to distribute Kunbi caste certificates and implement other demands.  Jarange demanded the dissolution of the Maratha quota sub-committee and urged for a separate ministry for the Maratha and Kunbi communities. He also criticized the state government for halting the issuance of Kunbi caste certificates, claiming that officials have been instructed not to issue them. **Devendra Fadnavis**, the Chief Minister of **Maharashtra**, has been accused by Jarange of being responsible for these actions.

recent_articles.title: Tell your ‘petty politicians’ not to blame the court for delay, CJI tells Thackeray-Shinde factions - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Supreme Court** expressed frustration with the "petty politicians" of the Uddhav Thackeray and Eknath Shinde factions of the Shiv Sena for making accusations against the court regarding delays in their dispute over the party symbol.  Chief Justice of India Surya Kant criticized the parties' media statements, urging them to refrain from such actions. Senior advocate Mukul Rohatgi, representing the Shinde faction, acknowledged that irresponsible comments were made and urged the court to set a specific date for final arguments. The case, which has been pending for years, centers on the Election Commission's February 2023 order assigning the symbol 'bow and arrow' to the Shinde faction, challenging the Thackeray faction's claim to the party name and symbol.

recent_articles.title: CM Fadnavis’ bike ride draws Opposition ire - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Devendra Fadnavis**, the **Maharashtra** Chief Minister, rode a motorbike to Vidhan Bhavan after Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** called for austerity measures. The move drew criticism from the Opposition who urged Ministers to use public transport instead.  **Sharad Pawar**, NCP SP president, questioned the timing of the austerity measures and demanded an all-party meeting with the Prime Minister. He also criticized the State Government ministers' language towards **Rahul Gandhi**, the Leader of Opposition in Parliament.

recent_articles.title: Ten new MLCs sworn in at Maharashtra Vidhan Bhavan - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ten newly elected members of the Maharashtra Legislative Council (MLC)** took their oaths on Thursday, May 14, 2026, following the end of nine sitting MLCs' terms. The new members include representatives from the **BJP**, **Shiv Sena**, and **NCP**.  The ceremony was presided over by **Legislative Council chairperson Ram Shinde** and attended by key figures like **Assembly Speaker Rahul Narwekar**, **Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis**, and **Deputy Chief Ministers Eknath Shinde and Sunetra Ajit**. The Upper House currently has 22 vacancies, with the majority of seats held by the **BJP** due to their dominance in the Legislative Assembly.

recent_articles.title: PM austerity appeal: State leaders take steps to limit their fuel use - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Union Home Minister Amit Shah**, and several other state chief ministers have implemented measures to reduce fuel consumption in response to the West Asia crisis.  These include reducing convoy sizes, promoting electric vehicles, and encouraging public transport use. **Yogi Adityanath**, **Rekha Gupta**, **Mohan Yadav**, and others have also taken steps to promote sustainability within their respective states.  **Devendra Fadnavis**, **Harsh Sanghavi**, and **Acharya Devvrat** have implemented similar measures in Maharashtra, Gujarat, and Bihar respectively.

recent_articles.title: TCS Nashik case: NCW flags ‘toxic work culture’, ‘zero POSH compliance’ - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **National Commission for Women (NCW)** has found that **Tata Consultancy Services (TCS)** in Nashik is failing to comply with the Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH) Act, citing pervasive harassment, religious denigration, and systemic bullying. The NCW's fact-finding committee observed that victims were intimidated into silence due to a lack of formal complaint mechanisms and a toxic workplace environment.  The committee has recommended action for TCS’ failure to comply with the POSH Act, as well as measures to protect complainants and ensure a safe working environment.

recent_articles.title: Rupali Chakankar appears before SIT in 'godman' Kharat case - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rupali Chakankar**, NCP leader and former State women’s panel chief, appeared before the special investigation team (SIT) in Nashik to answer questions about her alleged association with self-styled godman **Ashok Kharat**.  Ms. Chakankar resigned from both positions following revelations of her ties to **Kharat**, who is currently under arrest for rape and sexual exploitation. The Maharashtra Government has set up an SIT to investigate 12 cases against **Kharat** in Nashik and Ahilyanagar districts, with the SIT likely to question Ms. Chakankar about her connection to him.  Senior Congress leader **Nana Patole** alleged that **Kharat**’s life is in danger in prison and demanded the removal of four ministers connected to him from the state cabinet.

recent_articles.title: NCP(SP) leader splashed with ink by right-wing preacher - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Vikas Lawande**, spokesperson for the **NCP(SP)**, was allegedly attacked with black ink in Pune, Maharashtra on Saturday by a group led by right-wing preacher **Sangram Bhandare**. The attack followed **Lawande's** remarks about **Bhandare's** gurus, who are part of the Warkari movement.  **Lawande** reported the incident to the police and demanded action against the attackers. Several political leaders, including **Shashikant Shinde**, **Mehbub Shaikh**, and **Vijay Wadettiwar**, condemned the attack and called for protection of free speech.

recent_articles.title: Congress leader Varsha Gaikwad writes to Maharashtra Governor, seeks immediate enactment of Shakti Bill - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Varsha Gaikwad**, **Mumbai Congress president** and MP, has written to **Maharashtra Governor Jishnu Dev Varma** urging urgent action on rising crimes against women in the state.  Gaikwad requested the Governor's intervention regarding the **Shakti Criminal Laws (Maharashtra Amendment) Bill, 2020**, which awaits presidential assent, and urged the government to take strict action against atrocities against women. The letter comes amid protests following a four-year-old girl's alleged rape and murder in Pune district.

recent_articles.title: Maharashtra to upgrade 19 secondary ashram schools to junior college for tribals - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Maharashtra** government approved upgrading 19 secondary schools and 5 primary ashram schools to higher levels under the Tribal Development Department.  This decision aims to prevent dropouts and improve educational progress for tribal students in remote areas. The upgrades will create new positions and funding for these schools, which currently serve over 2.6 million students across the state.  The **Maharashtra** government's decision is part of a larger effort to provide quality education to all students, particularly those from marginalized communities.

recent_articles.title: Amid traffic woes on Mumbai-Pune highway, Maharashtra govt. inaugurates ‘Missing Link’ project - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Maharashtra government inaugurated the "Missing Link" project of the Mumbai-Pune Expressway on May 1, 2026, aiming to reduce travel time and bypass a risky ghat section near Lonavala. **CM Devendra Fadnavis** apologized for traffic congestion caused by the launch coinciding with a long weekend and heavy traffic due to car breakdowns. The project, completed at a cost of ₹7,181 crore, features Asia's widest underground tunnel and will reduce travel time between Mumbai and Pune by 30 minutes. **Supriya Sule**, an NCP(SP) leader, was among those stuck in the traffic jam.  The project is expected to boost the state's economy by ₹70,000 crore.

recent_articles.title: Residents urge BMRCL to include ‘Bilekahalli’ in IIMB metro station name on Bengaluru’s Pink Line metro - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Residents** in south Bengaluru have written to **Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation Limited (BMRCL)**, urging them to rename the upcoming “IIMB” metro station on the Pink Line as “IIMB–Bilekahalli” to recognize the locality’s identity.  The residents argue that naming the station solely after an institution risks overlooking the cultural context of the area and propose a name that balances modern infrastructure with local heritage. While **BMRCL** has received the letter, they confirmed that renaming a metro station involves a detailed procedure and requires approval from both state and central governments. This issue reflects a larger trend in Bengaluru where renaming metro stations is becoming increasingly contentious.

recent_articles.title: Fadnavis backs ex-CJI amid row over meeting with Dhirendra Shastri - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Devendra Fadnavis**, **Maharashtra Chief Minister**,  came out in support of former Chief Justice of India (CJI) B.R. Gavai after social activist Shyam Manav criticized his meeting with Dhirendra Shastri, chief priest of the Bageshwar Dham.  Manav argued that Gavai should not claim the legacy of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar and challenged Shastri to accept an anti-superstition panel's challenge. Senior Congress leader Vijay Wadettiwar accused political leaders of elevating babas (religious figures) in Maharashtra, criticizing Gavai for meeting Shastri.  The controversy comes after a similar incident involving Shastri's claims about Shivaji Maharaj.

recent_articles.title: No secret meeting took place with Uddhav Thackeray, says Devendra Fadnavis - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Devendra Fadnavis**, the **Maharashtra** Chief Minister, denied meeting **Uddhav Thackeray** despite reports of a secret meeting.  He stated that false news is being spread and action will be taken against those spreading it.  Fadnavis also addressed comments made by Dheerendra Shastri regarding historical meetings between Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj and Samarth Ramdas, stating there's no historical evidence to support such claims. He emphasized the importance of responsible reactions and avoiding unnecessary controversy.

recent_articles.title: BJP to contest four seats in upcoming Maharashtra Legislative Council polls - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **BJP** will contest four of the nine seats in the upcoming Maharashtra Legislative Council biennial elections, scheduled for May 12. The party's strategy was discussed at a meeting led by Chief Minister **Devendra Fadnavis**.  Candidates for the by-election for the seat vacated by Pradnya Satav are being shortlisted and will be sent to the central leadership for approval.  The Election Commission of India has set a quota of 29 votes for each council seat, with the by-election requiring 144 votes.

recent_articles.title: Mahayuti to launch signature campaign in Maharashtra on Women’s Reservation Bill - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The ruling Mahayuti** party in Maharashtra is launching a signature campaign from April 21 to collect one crore signatures of women, protesting the recent defeat of the Women’s Reservation Bill and Delimitation Bill. **Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis** challenged the opposition parties for an open debate on the issue, accusing them of stalling increased women's reservation and SC/ST reservations.  **Supriya Sule**, an NCP SP MP, and **Praniti Shinde**, a Congress MP, accepted the challenge, while **Rahul Gandhi**, the Congress leader, was accused by Fadnavis of being a liar. The opposition parties countered that the government is trying to use the issue for political gain ahead of elections in West Bengal and Tamil Nadu.

recent_articles.title: Chaturvedi’s grumbling over defeat of Women’s Bill’ flies in the face of her party’s stand - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Shiv Sena UBT** leader Priyanka Chaturvedi criticized the defeat of the Women’s Reservation Bill in the Lok Sabha, expressing her opposition to its inclusion with the Delimitation Bill. **Sanjay Raut**, a Shiv Sena UBT MP, stated that the party opposed the bill because it was presented as a means for the BJP to advance their own agenda. Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis condemned the opposition's actions, calling them hypocritical and stating that they prioritized politics over progress.

recent_articles.title: Maharashtra’s textile industry has suffered ₹4,000-crore loss: MLA - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rais Shaikh**, a Samajwadi Party MLA from Bhiwandi, Maharashtra, has reported that the textile industry in his district suffered losses of ₹4,000 crore in March 2026 due to the ongoing West Asia conflict.  Shaikh claims this disruption is causing two days of weekly shutdowns and impacting employment for thousands of workers. He has written to **Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis** requesting a financial package to support the industry.

recent_articles.title: CM Fadnavis to conduct probe in Chhagan Bhujbal’s helicopter landing in parking lot - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chhagan Bhujbal**, Maharashtra Food and Civil Supplies Minister, was aboard a helicopter that landed unexpectedly in Khanwadi village near Pune on Saturday. The incident occurred while the helicopter was traveling from Nashik to attend the 200th birth anniversary of Jyotiba Phule. **Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis** stated the incident would be investigated and confirmed it was a smooth landing with no issues.

recent_articles.title: Maharashtra government inaugurates Metro 9 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis** inaugurated the first phase of Metro Line 9, marking a significant milestone in Mumbai's metro expansion. The 4.97 km line connects Dahisar and Kashigaon with an interchange at Dahisar (E), linking to existing lines like Line 7 and Line 3. **Deputy CM Eknath Shinde** highlighted the project's benefits for commuters, including reduced traffic congestion and faster travel times.  The MMRDA has also released revised timetables for the metro corridors, aiming for seamless passenger movement and enhanced network efficiency.

recent_articles.title: Battle for Baramati: Sunetra Pawar files nomination, Sharad Pawar’s photo displayed during NCP rally - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sunetra Pawar**, daughter of **Sharad Pawar**, filed her nomination as the Nationalist Congress Party candidate for the upcoming Baramati by-election.  She was accompanied by Deputy Chief Minister **Eknath Shinde** and BJP cabinet minister **Chandrashekhar Bawankule**. **Sharad Pawar** expressed disapproval of his photo being displayed alongside **Narendra Modi** and **Amit Shah**, stating that it was wrong to do so. While senior NCP leaders, **Praful Patel** and **Sunil Tatkare**, suggested speaking with the Congress leadership for an unopposed election, Sunetra Pawar's son, **Parth**, indicated he would not engage in such negotiations.  **Sanjay Raut** of Shiv Sena UBT expressed that it was acceptable to field a candidate in elections.

recent_articles.title: ED to investigate into assets of self-styled godman Kharat; call record leaks will be probed: Fadnavis - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis** announced that the **Enforcement Directorate (ED)** will investigate the assets of self-styled godman Ashok Kharat, who is facing multiple rape and fraud accusations.  Mr. Fadnavis also stated that the leak of call detail records in the case will be investigated and that action would be taken against those responsible. He emphasized that evidence-based action would be taken in sensitive cases like this, adding that more individuals are coming forward with information about Kharat's alleged wrongdoing.

recent_articles.title: Unseasonal rains in Maharashtra: Govt will provide farmers all assistance, promises CM - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Maharashtra** Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis announced that his government will provide assistance to farmers who have suffered crop damage and financial losses due to unseasonal rains. The rains, accompanied by hailstorms and gusty winds, have affected over 1.22 lakh hectares of land in several districts of the state, particularly north Maharashtra, western Maharashtra, Marathwada, and Vidarbha.  **Fadnavis** stated that the government will conduct surveys and provide compensation as it has done in previous instances of unseasonal rain or hailstorms.

recent_articles.title: MVA rift: Uddhav likely to back Sunetra Pawar in Baramati bypoll, but Congress not on board - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Congress** broke with its MVA partners, declaring it would contest the upcoming Baramati Assembly by-election.  **Sunetra Pawar**, widow of deceased NCP leader **Ajit Pawar**, is the ruling alliance's candidate. **Shiv Sena (UBT)** chief **Uddhav Thackeray** is expected to announce his party's decision soon, with sources indicating a likely support for **Sunetra Pawar**.  The Congress, however, has decided to contest the by-election independently, citing a lack of communication and participation in alliance discussions.

recent_articles.title: Sunetra Pawar to file nomination on April 6, contest won’t be unopposed in Baramati - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sunetra Pawar**, the Deputy Chief Minister of Maharashtra, will file her nomination for the Baramati by-election on April 6th. The seat fell vacant after the death of her husband **Ajit Pawar** in an air crash earlier this year.  The election is expected to test the unity of the opposition Maha Vikas Aghadi alliance as allies may compete against each other. While the Nationalist Congress Party (NCP) has declared it will not field a candidate against Sunetra Pawar, the Maharashtra Congress and Shiv Sena UBT have expressed their intention to support a candidate in Baramati.

recent_articles.title: Fadnavis demands SIR in Maharashtra, says problems with electoral rolls - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Devendra Fadnavis**, the Chief Minister of Maharashtra, stated that his state seeks a Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. He expressed concern over existing issues with the electoral rolls and argued that while opposition parties acknowledge these problems, they oppose SIR.  Fadnavis made this statement during an informal conversation at his official residence 'Varsha' on Diwali.

recent_articles.title: Pakistan jibes become central to BJP’s Assam poll narrative - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Himanta Biswa Sarma**, the Chief Minister of Assam, has criticized **Lurinjyoti Gogoi**, the AJP candidate for Guwahati Central constituency, for his alleged links to "anti-national" elements.  Sarma also attacked **Sujata Gurung Chowdhury**, Kunki Chowdhury's mother, for publicly supporting Sharjeel Imam and Umar Khalid, both accused in the 2020 Delhi riots case. The controversy has drawn attention to Pakistan as a topic of discussion in the Assam election. **Saadulla**, a former Prime Minister of Assam, is being used by the BJP to highlight alleged infiltration attempts into the state during his tenure.

recent_articles.title: What is the Maharashtra Freedom of Religion Bill? | Explained - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Maharashtra** government passed the Maharashtra Freedom of Religion Bill, 2026, which aims to prohibit unlawful religious conversions. The bill mandates a 60-day notice period for conversion and requires police registration of complaints related to forced conversions.  Civil society organizations have expressed concerns about the bill's potential impact on personal liberty and its constitutionality.  The bill has been supported by **Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis**, who stated that it is necessary to address increasing cases of forcible religious conversions. The bill has also been criticized for potentially targeting minority communities and raising administrative concerns regarding the lack of a certification system for religions.

recent_articles.title: People spreading rumours on lockdown will be booked: CM Fadnavis - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Devendra Fadnavis**, the Chief Minister of **Maharashtra**, announced that the central government's decision to reduce excise duty on fossil fuels will protect consumers from rising global crude oil prices caused by the ongoing conflict in West Asia.  The reduction, which amounts to ₹10 per litre for petrol and diesel, will be borne by the government and oil companies. **Fadnavis** assured citizens that there is no shortage of fuel in India and urged them not to hoard it. The government has also increased commercial LPG supply in Maharashtra to 50% of pre-crisis levels and prioritized the supply of 5-kg Free Trade LPG (FTL) cylinders for migrant workers.

recent_articles.title: 2026 Tamil Nadu Assembly election will be a close battle, says P. Chidambaram - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The upcoming 2026 Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly election is expected to be a close contest between two strong fronts, the DMK-Congress alliance and the AIADMK. Veteran Congress leader P. Chidambaram believes that while the BJP will try to influence the election, the DMK alliance will ultimately secure a comfortable majority. He acknowledges the potential for a hung assembly with Vijayakanth's Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam potentially impacting the outcome but predicts the DMK alliance will form the government.

recent_articles.title: Zero FIR in Ajit Pawar crash an attempt to defame Maharashtra, says Fadnavis - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Maharashtra** Chief Minister **Devendra Fadnavis** stated that the zero FIR registered in Bengaluru regarding the plane crash that killed then Deputy Chief Minister Ajit Pawar was an attempt by the neighboring **Karnataka** government to defame the state.  He clarified that a probe is underway by the Criminal Investigation Department and an Accidental Death Report (ADR) has been filed, adding that the state government had also requested a Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) probe as per the family's wishes. **Fadnavis** emphasized that the zero FIR was not intended to hinder an impartial probe and urged **Rohit Pawar**, Ajit Pawar’s nephew, to use legal avenues if he felt aggrieved.

recent_articles.title: Maharashtra will be at the forefront of India’s orange economy: CM Fadnavis - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis** of **Maharashtra** stated that Mumbai and the state have the potential to become a global hub for the AVGC sector, contributing significantly to India's "orange economy."  He highlighted the growing viability of esports as a career path and emphasized the importance of digital content and creator economies in future economic growth. The festival, Gen O – Pixels & Play, hosted by **EFlag Corp**, aims to foster policy support for Maharashtra's leadership in gaming, creator economy, and digital infrastructure. The event brings together creators, innovators, and global stakeholders to explore opportunities within India's emerging creative and digital economy.

recent_articles.title: Under fire over links with rape accused godman, Maharashtra women’s panel chief quits - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rupali Chakankar**, chairperson of the **Maharashtra State Commission for Women**, resigned after facing pressure to step down following her association with accused rape-accused ‘godman’ Ashok Kharat.  Chakankar was summoned to the official residence of **Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis** and was asked to resign due to public outcry over the photos and videos that surfaced showing her interacting with Kharat. The opposition criticized the government's delayed action, alleging a lack of coordination within the Mahayuti alliance and suggesting Chakankar’s resignation is part of a larger power play by the BJP.

recent_articles.title: Gudi Padwa marked by processions across Maharashtra - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Citizens** across **Maharashtra** celebrated the first day of the Marathi New Year, Gudi Padwa, with processions and religious gatherings.  **Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis**, who attended a procession in Nagpur, urged citizens to adopt positive resolutions for the new year while emphasizing collective efforts for national progress.  **Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde** participated in a procession in Thane, which included performances by Dhol and Tasha troupes and Lezim dancers.

recent_articles.title: How Maharashtra Legislature cleared the Freedom of Religion Bill, and why most of the opposition parties did not oppose it - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Maharashtra** legislature passed the Freedom of Religion Bill, making it the 13th state in India to have such legislation.  While the bill was supported by opposition parties like the Shiv Sena UBT and NCP SP, concerns were raised about its potential infringement on religious freedom and lack of empirical data to justify its need. The bill aims to crack down on forced conversions but has faced criticism from Congress MLA Aslam Sheikh who called it regressive and a one-sided target against a particular community.  **Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis**, however, argued that the current legal framework was insufficient to handle the law and order situation caused by such cases.

recent_articles.title: Centre and State government have failed to manage LPG shortage: NCP-SP leader Jayant Patil - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Nationalist Congress Party (NCP)-SP** accused the **BJP-led Mahayuti government** of failing to manage the LPG gas shortage and blaming the opposition for the crisis.  **Jayant Patil**, an NCP-SP senior leader, stated that the government has refused to share information on the situation and take citizens and opposition into confidence. **Devendra Fadnavis**, the Chief Minister, previously accused the opposition, including **Rahul Gandhi**, of creating panic about the shortage, while **Chhagan Bhujbal**, the Food and Civil Supplies Minister, claimed authorities seized 1,208 LPG cylinders during a crackdown on stockpiling.

recent_articles.title: Freedom of Religion Bill passed in Maharashtra Assembly; 'not against any community', says Fadnavis - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Maharashtra Assembly passed the Freedom of Religion Bill 2026, which prohibits religious conversions through coercion, fraud, or inducement. The bill mandates a seven-year prison sentence and ₹1 lakh fine for those involved in unlawful conversions, with increased penalties for minors, vulnerable groups, and repeat offenders.  **Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis** emphasized the bill's aim to protect citizens from fraudulent conversions while safeguarding constitutional rights. Opposition parties raised concerns about potential "vigilantism" and the bill's impact on religious freedom.

recent_articles.title: No shortage of LPG, Oppn. creating panic among public, says Fadnavis - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article:
##  Fadnavis Blames Congress for LPG Shortages, Denies Supply Crisis

Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis has refuted claims of an LPG shortage in the state, blaming the opposition Congress for creating panic and long queues at distribution centers. He insists that there is no actual shortage but rather a result of misinformation spread by the Congress. Fadnavis accused the party of misleading the public and insulting Prime Minister Narendra Modi while speaking to reporters.  The situation has been further complicated by price hikes, technical issues with booking cylinders, delays in deliveries, and a restricted commercial supply for the hospitality sector. 

Congress members have criticized the government's handling of the crisis, pointing to the shutdowns of numerous hotels due to the shortage. They also questioned the Prime Minister's silence on the issue, highlighting his past successes in uniting international leaders.
